No resolved edge in the full 327-file graph names get_arq_by_uuid as a call target. The call likely occurs on a _CyborgClient local variable returned by get_client(), which is a known link-graph blind spot (calls on local variables). Callers with get_arq_by_uuid usage are expected in nova.compute or nova.conductor (not yet extracted).

evaluatedFindings.title: HMAC validation of metadata proxy request conditionally skipped when shared secret is unconfigured
evaluatedFindings.reason: The confirmed finding's lineRange (276-280) does not overlap the KB securitySurface entry-point (line 97, @webob.dec.wsgify). Per protocol, a source requires the finding to overlap an entry-point — this finding is at the authentication check, not at the HTTP request entry. The finding describes CWE-306 (missing authentication): when CONF.neutron.metadata_proxy_shared_secret is unset, X-Metadata-Provider and X-Forwarded-For headers are accepted without HMAC validation. The unauthenticated provider_id flows to neutron.list_subnets(advanced_service_providers=[provider_id]) at line 209-212 (via _get_instance_id_from_lb). This is an authentication-bypass resulting in information disclosure — not an injection taint chain per the correlation protocol. The vulnerability is real and should be tracked as a standalone finding; a future run could check if the KB adds an entry-point at line 265 (_handle_instance_id_request_from_lb) to enable chain-002.
